tools._comment: Gateway tool-result discipline (B-4). A tool result IS context: bound it, ANNOUNCE the bound so the organ can re-derive instead of assuming it saw everything, and never let a binary file reach a model. An unbounded readFile on a downloaded PDF once pushed a single organ call to 877k input tokens.

record._comment: The RECORD of a tool call — what the [TOOL EXECUTION LOG] keeps of each result for everyone after the organ that ran it: the verifier, Cortex, the evidence-floor checks (B-28; platform/context/tool-record.mjs). A result up to verbatim_chars is kept word for word. A larger one is stored in full in Firestore tool_results/<id> (expiring after store_ttl_days via the TTL policy in firestore.indexes.json) and replaced in the log by a utility-model digest of about digest_target_chars (hard cap digest_max_chars) plus the ref; if the digest fails, an excerpt with its cut stated. Never cut silently: it kept 500 chars of every result, unmarked, and a verifier promised complete evidence never saw past an agenda. The verifier re-check and Cortex request_context fetch the full result by ref. arg_chars / terminal_arg_chars bound the arguments shown (terminal tools carry the verdict payload).

versioning._comment: Canonical commit format: v{YYYY}.{MM}.{DD}.{index}.{subindex}: description. This is the FOREVER format. The extractVersion() regex in app/src/app/api/upgrade/route.ts MUST match this. A temporary vX.Y.Z format was used during v5.0-v5.3 and is supported for back-compat only.

workspaces._comment: Canonical workspace directories the daemon reads from. Manifests MUST target these paths.
